machine: Apple M4, 16 GB, macOS, PyTorch 2.14 MPS
frames: 42 representative frames (1280x720) from 6 SceneSeen videos; 30 queries

candidates.why: Per-query calibrated scores; any number of text queries; clean labels; 75-94% precise at >=0.4 in review.
7x slower on MPS, 3x the accelerator memory; with many categories in one prompt it returns merged phrases ('sneakers shoes', 'smartphone tablet') that cannot be mapped to a taxonomy.

Generic labels (man / woman / human face = 167 of 253 detections), very few commercial objects, and NO confidence scores, so precision cannot be controlled. Open-vocabulary mode needs one generation per query.
Fastest by far, but about half of a blind sample of 48 detections >=0.4 were wrong (logo->lamp, face->television).

not_evaluated.MM-Grounding-DINO: same architecture family and prompt format as Grounding DINO (same merged-label and MPS-speed problems expected); not downloaded on a slow connection
not_evaluated.YOLO-World / YOLOE: AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics) licence is unsuitable for a commercial product
not_evaluated.SAM 2: masks and tracking add nothing to 'which commercial objects are in this scene'; boxes are enough for this phase
